choice: tags.direction wins over tags["camera:direction"] when both exist; the first value of a ';' list is used; cardinal letters use the 16-point compass in 22.5-degree steps (N=0, NE=45, SW=225); '0' gives 0, not null; text like 'forward' gives null
options: Only accept the 8 main compass points
text: How should parseOverpass read camera direction when the JSDoc leaves details open?
why: The JSDoc names direction first and gives '90;270' -> 90 and 'NE' -> 45; the rest follows the usual OSM compass convention
